Subject: Dedicated GPU capacity architecture review — slot coordination & timezone check

Hi Anna —

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday. Per our conversation Finova is preparing to move an internal model into a reserved GPU pool and you asked for a technical architecture review (pool sizing, autoscaling policy, isolation/tenancy patterns). We typically run a 60–75 minute deep-dive with engineering + ops so we can walk through:

- current workload profile (seq lengths, concurrency, qps)
- recommended pool topology and failover
- autoscaling triggers and burst strategies
- isolation options (dedicated pools, pinning, soft isolation)
- QA: latency SLOs vs cost tradeoffs and quantization notes

Proposed slots (all in PDT):
- Tue July 14, 10:00–11:15 PDT
- Wed July 15, 08:00–09:15 PDT (early)
- Thu July 16, 14:00–15:15 PDT

I’ve attached an outline slide and a sample workload CSV you can share with your infra team if helpful. Also pasted a short agenda below.

Agenda (60–75m):
1) 5m quick context
2) 20m Finova workload walkthrough (you)
3) 25m Redwood architecture & pool sizing recommendation
4) 10–15m autoscale/fallback discussion
5) 5m action items / next steps

Next steps: please confirm which slot works and who from your side will join (security/ops/infra). If none of the times suit, tell us your availability and we’ll adapt.

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_dedicated_capacity_slide_v2.pdf (slides), finova_prod_workload_sample.csv (csv sample)
